/**
 * English catalogue. This file is the source of truth for the key set: every
 * other language is typed as `Messages`, so a key added here and forgotten
 * there is a typecheck error rather than an English string appearing in the
 * middle of a translated page.
 *
 * Keys are flat and dotted, namespaced by the component that owns them. Flat
 * beats nested here because `t("dialog.close")` can then be checked against a
 * union of literal keys, and because overriding the wording of one component
 * is then a single entry rather than a nested merge.
 */

/** Every message the library can render. */
export type MessageKey = keyof typeof en;

/**
 * The contract each language implements. Values are widened to `MessageValue`
 * so a translation may use plural forms where English needs none, or one fixed
 * string where English needs plural forms.
 */
export type Messages = Readonly<Record<MessageKey, MessageValue>>;

/**
 * Arabic catalogue (Modern Standard Arabic).
 *
 * Arabic is the language that decides whether a plural implementation is real:
 * `Intl.PluralRules("ar")` returns all six CLDR categories — zero for 0, one
 * for 1, two for 2, few for 3–10, many for 11–99 and other from 100 up — and
 * each one takes a different noun form. The counted-noun entries below spell
 * out all six, so nothing ever reads as the Arabic equivalent of "1 rows".
 */
import type { Messages } from "./en";

/**
 * French catalogue.
 *
 * French typography puts a space before the double punctuation marks, and it
 * must not be a plain space or the mark wraps onto its own line. The strings
 * below use U+202F (narrow no-break space) before `?`, `!` and `;`, and U+00A0
 * (no-break space) before `:`, which is what the Imprimerie nationale rules
 * call for and what every French publication follows.
 *
 * `many` is a real category here, not padding: CLDR gives French a `many` form
 * for round millions, so 1 000 000 reads "1 000 000 de lignes" rather than the
 * ungrammatical "1 000 000 lignes".
 */

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Blocking confirmation dialog with a destructive-safe action and a cancel button; it cannot be dismissed by clicking the overlay.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline status message. A grid keeps an optional leading icon aligned with the title while the description wraps under both.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round user image that falls back to initials on a muted disc while the image loads or fails.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status or category label. Status variants use their own colour ramps, so they stay readable even when the brand colour is itself red.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Trail of ancestor links ending in the current page. The separator chevron points along the reading direction.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary action control. Six variants, three sizes plus icon sizes, a loading state, and asChild composition for links.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface container with header, content and footer slots, plus an action slot that aligns to the end of the header row.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Square checkbox with checked and indeterminate indicators, sized to sit inline with body text.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Single region that shows or hides its content, with no styling opinions beyond the open/closed state.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable command palette on cmdk, usable inline or inside a dialog as a spotlight-style launcher.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Menu raised by a right-click or long-press on its trigger area, with the same anatomy as the dropdown menu.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Button that copies a value to the clipboard and swaps its icon to a check while the copy is fresh. Works icon-only or with a label.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog centred over a dimming overlay, with header, footer and a close affordance in the inline-end corner.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu opened from a button, with items, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators, shortcuts and nested submenus.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form bindings that wire a label, description and validation message to a control through ARIA.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Preview card revealed when a pointer rests on its trigger; purely informational, so it never traps focus.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: One-time-password field whose characters are split across individually styled slots.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field on the shared control-height scale, with invalid and disabled states wired to ARIA.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form label bound to a control, dimmed automatically when the control it labels is disabled.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation built from button styles, with previous/next arrows that turn to follow the reading direction.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, used for rich content that needs focus, such as a small form or a picker.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate progress bar whose fill grows from the reading edge, so it runs right-to-left under `dir="rtl"`.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Set of mutually exclusive options, each rendered as a circle with a filled indicator.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scrollable region with a slim, themed scrollbar that replaces the native one on every platform.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Accessible dropdown select built on Radix, with a trigger on the control-height scale and a portalled listbox.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider. Decorative by default, so screen readers skip it.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Dialog that slides in from a screen edge; the `start` and `end` sides follow the reading direction, so they mirror in RTL.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Shimmering placeholder that holds layout space while content loads.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Range input for one or more values, with a thumb rendered per value and full keyboard support.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Toast system on sonner: a themed viewport that follows the app's theme and direction, plus `notify` for glass toasts with a tone chip, an action and a draining progress bar.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off toggle whose thumb travels in the reading direction, so it works unchanged in RTL.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data table primitives in an overflow container, with logical text alignment so headers read correctly in RTL.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed panels on the Radix primitive: an inset rail of triggers with the active one lifted onto the background.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field that matches the input styling and grows with its content.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Row of toggles that share one variant and size and join into a single seamless control.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state button that stays pressed, on the shared control-height scale.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short text hint shown on hover or focus, with an arrow pointing back at its trigger.

items.name: app-sidebar
items.title: App Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible application sidebar: a provider, the shell with header, content and footer slots, grouped menus with icon-only collapsing, a trigger, and the inset that holds the page.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts wrappers that map series keys to labels and token colours, plus tooltip and legend content styled with the design system's surfaces.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code surface with a file-name bar, optional line numbers and a copy button that confirms through a toast. Deliberately unhighlighted: no tokenizer dependency, no hydration mismatch.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Confirmation prompt over AlertDialog that awaits an async handler, keeps itself open while the action runs, and shows a spinner on the confirm button.

items.name: cta-banner
items.title: Cta Banner
items.description: Closing call to action on the brand surface, with an eyebrow, a display title, a line of copy, actions and a soft decorative glow.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Generic table with client-side search, sorting, row selection, column visibility and pagination, written with plain React state rather than a table library.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centred placeholder for a view with nothing in it yet: an icon, a title, a short explanation and an optional action.

items.name: error-state
items.title: Error State
items.description: Centred failure panel with a destructive-tinted icon, a title, the error message and a retry button.

items.name: faq
items.title: Faq
items.description: Frequently asked questions as an accordion, optionally with the section heading parked in its own column beside the list.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: Auto-fitting grid of feature cards, each with an icon, a title, a description and an optional link that makes the whole card clickable.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: Toolbar row for list views: a search field, dropdown filters, an action cluster and a row of dismissible chips showing what is currently applied.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Marketing hero with eyebrow, display title, description, actions and optional media, in a stacked, centered or split layout.

items.name: install-command
items.title: Install Command
items.description: Install snippet with npm, pnpm, yarn and bun tabs and a one-click copy, the way a library's own docs present it. Remembers the reader's package manager.

items.name: language-select
items.title: Language Select
items.description: Language picker: a dropdown listing each language in its own script, which sets `lang` and `dir` on the document so the whole page — including RTL layout and the per-script font stack — follows the choice.

items.name: logo-marquee
items.title: Logo Marquee
items.description: Endlessly scrolling strip of logos that pauses on hover, mirrors its direction in RTL, and falls back to a static wrapped row under reduced motion.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Top-of-page banner: optional breadcrumb trail, a title with a supporting line, and an action cluster parked at the inline end.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: Pricing tiers side by side with a monthly/annual switch, where the featured tier sits on the brand surface and lifts above the row.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.description: Site footer with a brand blurb, column groups of links, a social and legal row, and a copyright line, each group its own navigation landmark.

items.name: site-navbar
items.title: Site Navbar
items.description: Sticky glass site header with a logo slot, inline navigation, action slot, and a sheet-based menu below the medium breakpoint.

items.name: stat-bento
items.title: Stat Bento
items.description: Bento grid of headline numbers in mixed tile sizes, with counters that animate the first time their tile scrolls into view.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: KPI tile showing a label, a headline value, an optional icon and a trend delta, with a skeleton stand-in while the figure loads.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Wall of customer quotes, either as an even grid or as a masonry-style column flow, each card carrying an avatar, a name, a role and an optional logo.

items.name: theme-select
items.title: Theme Select
items.description: Colour-mode picker: a dropdown listing light, dark and system, with the active mode on the trigger and the choice written straight to the document root.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.title: Dashboard Shell
items.description: Application shell: a collapsible sidebar driven by prop data, a sticky top bar with a trigger, breadcrumbs, search and a user menu, and the page in the inset.

items.name: error-pages
items.title: Error Pages
items.description: Full-page error screens: a 404 and a 500, both built on one shared layout with an oversized display code, a message and recovery actions.

items.name: forgot-password
items.title: Forgot Password
items.description: Password recovery page: an email field that, once sent, is replaced by a confirmation panel with a resend action.

items.name: login-centered
items.title: Login Centered
items.description: Single-column sign-in page: one centred card floating over a softly patterned, glowing backdrop.

items.name: login-split
items.title: Login Split
items.description: Two-column sign-in page: a cinematic brand panel on the inline start and a fully controlled email and password form on the inline end.

items.name: otp-verify
items.title: Otp Verify
items.description: One-time-code verification page: split OTP slots, a masked destination line, an auto-submit on completion and a resend link gated by a countdown.

items.name: register
items.title: Register
items.description: Account creation page with name, email, a password field scored by a live strength meter, a confirmation field and a terms checkbox.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings Page
items.description: Settings layout: a sticky anchor-link nav on the inline start and profile, preferences, appearance and danger-zone cards on the inline end.

items.name: use-clipboard
items.title: Use Clipboard
items.description: Writes text to the clipboard and reports success for a couple of seconds, falling back to a detached textarea where the async API is blocked.

items.name: use-locale
items.title: Use Locale
items.description: Language and writing direction for the whole document: writes `lang` and `dir` on `<html>`, remembers the choice, and keeps every tab in step.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: Use Theme
items.description: Colour-mode state for the whole document: light, dark, or follow the system. Persists the choice, keeps every tab in step, and reacts when the OS preference flips.
